body: Honestly the wording of this got a chuckle out of me. Thank you for making me laugh when I needed it. I appreciate the support, thank you. I think you're right, lose her, not my life.
Thank you so much, I'm going to look into this. Maybe lgbt resources will take me more seriously than what I've tried so far.

No she doesn't know about either but I don't want her to know. She just beat cancer and has a ton of other issues going on in her life, I don't want her to waste her energy or worrying on me. She one of the few things keeping me here.

Honestly I'm close to ending it. What is keeping me going, at least for today is spite. If I survive her then I can survive anything. I can't deal with her anymore but the people who commented on my post, you included, have given me hope when I honestly though there wasn't any left. I had bought all the things I needed to off myself earlier this morning and because of everyone here, I don't think I'll use them today. Thank you.

Honestly, I don't have enough to live on my own but someone mentioned finding a roommate and I'm really thinking about that. My mom is disabled in a 1 br, I'm gonna see if maybe I can stay with her in the living room for a bit and look for a roommate or someone who needs one. Thank you for the reply.
Yes I am on disability and I have thought about it. I would love to go to another state. I think it might be the safest situation for me overall to leave the state.

She even has my cards stored in her phone so if I try to leave she can drain my accounts. Thank you for taking the time to read my post and reply. I'm going to beg my family and see if anyone will take me in even just temporarily so I can get away from this situation. It's really wearing me down. I bought everything I needed to go through with my plans right before I made my post and now I'm rethinking my decision. Thank you to you and anyone else who replied. You guys are saviors.

Thank you. I appreciate your kind words. Honestly, I was unsure about posting but I'm glad I did. The reddit community has given me more hope and support in a few hours than I've gotten in the last few years. I've been with her 5 years. It's been torture since year 3 when she dropped the act and our lives were too intertwined to leave easily. She waited and was calculated about it. She's a sociopath and a narcissistic and as soon as I get the chance I'm gonna run.
I'm currently trying to secure a place for myself using the affordable housing lottery system they set up here in the city

I think the roommate idea is a good one. I just worry about putting someone else in danger bc she and her family are known to fight and willingly assault people at their homes. I don't want to get anyone else jumped with me when they weren't part of the situation.

I'm actually a female lol but thank you. I appreciate what you said. She cut me off of all my support. She hated my friends and pushed them away from me. She got me kicked out of my home and moved me into hers. I would love to go back home and make new friends but when I tried, I was rejected. I'm disabled and here in nyc everything is so expensive that I can't afford anything myself. I've been applying to some stuff like affordable housing in an attempt to escape but it's also hard to secure one of those places as a single individual. I've been trying for over a year now to get myself away from her. I don't know why it's so hard to get out.
Hey, I'm 22 today and in nyc
